blurb: Guests can enjoy private yacht charters customized for events like family outings, romantic evenings, or group celebrations. The boat features a full-length shaded roof, restroom, and comfortable seating. Charter options include sun tours, anchoring at local spots, dinner cruises, and custom trips.
